notes.title: Publisher Announcement
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We have an announcement to make for today. We have signed a publishing deal with the folks from Deck13 Spotlight. You might know them from Chained Echoes or CrossCode. They understand the JRPG market and love these kind of games nearly as much as we do so it was a natural fit. For you nothing changes, for us it means more resources in general to fulfill our vision - and someone taking care of the business side of things. Or in other words: Less bureaucracy for us. Yay.[/p][p][/p][p][u]The following press release was sent out just a couple of seconds ago:[/u][/p][p][/p][p]Today publisher Deck13 Spotlight and developer Datadyne are thrilled to announce that the glorious JRPG [i]Forge of the Fae[/i] joins the Publishers portfolio. The international Team of Datadyne is a perfect fit for the company which brought you [i]CrossCode[/i] and [i]Chained Echoes[/i].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="S9jgHo82Tlk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Set in a world inspired by 1800s Ireland, [i]Forge of the Fae[/i] plunges players into a [b]beautifully crafted narrative[/b] where humans and fae are in conflict. As [b]an ancient power awakens[/b] and tensions rise, players will follow the journey of Fiora, a young inventor, as she uncovers the secrets of her world while navigating a complex mystery and discovering who she can become. [b]Decisions made will influence the outcome[/b], giving players control over the story’s direction and creating a more personal experience.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Classic Turn-Based Combat and Puzzle-Solving[/b][/p][p]Drawing inspiration from [b]classic JRPGs[/b], [i]Forge of the Fae[/i] features a [b]deep turn-based combat[/b] system where strategy reigns supreme. Players will be challenged to master the "ARC Crystal System" and "Adrenaline" systems, which offer versatile, [b]customizable spells and abilities, adding depth and excitement to combat[/b]. Alongside the action, [b]intricate puzzles[/b] scattered throughout the world encourage [b]exploration and reward players[/b] with powerful items and hidden lore.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722821/9484551d1704d58bc6a6a08d8c78131b545b82ef.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]“[i]Forge of the Fae is a perfect match for us[/i]”, says Michael Hoss, Head of Product at Deck13 Spotlight. “[i]Even in its early stages it is incredibly well crafted and pulls all the right triggers. Working with Datadyne over the last couple of weeks also showed us what an amazing team is building this masterpiece.[/i]” “We have found a reliable partner with Deck13 Spotlight”, added David Schooley from Datadyne. ”[i]Not only do they fully understand the vision of the game but they also know the JRPG market so well. We are super excited for the upcoming journey![/i]”[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722821/cc9d077bfc030dfb0c14d3d26663657dd4a4bc41.png"][/img][/p][p][i][b]Forge of the Fae[/b][/i][b] will release 2027 for PC and Consoles. A free demo is available through Steam and the game will be playable at the Indie Arena Booth at this year's Gamescom in Cologne and at Tokyo Game Show later this year. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2160070/Forge_of_the_Fae/"][u]Wishlist[/u][/url] the game now on Steam.[/b][/p]

notes.title: This is It!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722821/987a57e30682565b1348c8208ff349eb5c16a029.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

We did it! Surpassing $200K is an [b]incredible achievement[/b], and we couldn’t have done it without your overwhelming support. With just 2 hours left in the campaign, this is the final opportunity to jump in, secure your [b]exclusive rewards, and be part of something truly special.[/b]

If you've been waiting to pledge or upgrade your reward, [b]now is the time![/b]

[h1]Stretch Goal Hit: Advanced Weather System[/h1]
Thanks to your [b]incredible support[/b], we’ve unlocked the Advanced Weather System, which will bring the world of Forge of the Fae to life like [b]never before![/b] 🌧️⛈️

This system will add [b]dynamic weather[/b] to the world of Forge of the Fae, creating a [b]more immersive[/b] experience. Rain, storms, wind, fog, and frost will not only enhance the atmosphere but also impact gameplay in exciting ways. Whether it’s a storm rolling in during a pivotal moment or frost setting the tone for an icy morning, every day in the game will feel alive and unique. 😼

[h1]A Final Thank You[/h1]
Your enthusiasm, shares, and support have driven this campaign to heights we could only dream of. [b]Every single backer[/b] has played a role in shaping Forge of the Fae, and we can’t wait to deliver this [b]epic adventure[/b] to all of you.

With only a [b]couple of hours left[/b], let's hit this final stretch!! Share the campaign, encourage friends to join in, and let’s end this campaign on the highest note possible!❤️‍🔥

Thank you so much for believing in Forge of the Fae. You’ve made this journey [b]truly unforgettable[/b]. Let’s cross the finish line strong! 

Stay tuned for what's next~😻

[b]Yoshino Aoki[/b], the legendary composer behind iconic titles like [i]Breath of Fire III & IV[/i], the [i]Mega Man Battle Network[/i] series, and [i]Final Fantasy XV[/i], has already contributed one incredible track to Forge of the Fae. Yoshino-san has told us how excited she is to return for more compositions, and this stretch goal will [b]make it happen![/b] Her music has defined some of the most beloved RPGs in gaming history, and we’re honored to have her help bring the world of Forge of the Fae to life.

notes.title: 4 Days to Go! Special Behind the Scenes Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722821/026b2246456295f47e4d423d14e25d6d3133e2c9.png[/img]

Hi everyone! We’re down to [b]4 days remaining[/b] in the campaign, and we’re so excited to share these final days with you! It's been an incredible ride so far, and today we'd like to share a little bit of what goes on behind the scenes by going over some of the process that takes place while building out a key location such as [b]Taliesin City[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722821/eb6ba700bc8ae1c4a7ad03839ba3c50c9511cd7c.png[/img]

The first step of the process is getting an understanding of its purpose in the game, and detailing all of the key locations and where they fit in the story. It's important that a destination as large and involved as Taliesin is thoroughly thought out in order to ensure that it can accommodate the game's story from start to finish with a proper game flow for the player. 

Our solution for achieving this was to district out the city, and open up the unique districts throughout different points in the game. Eventually the player will have access to the full city, but by the time they do they'll have learned its entire layout and feel comfortably at home exploring it in its entirety.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722821/3a7e77412bdf3ab5748479ec1d522d895d4113e2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722821/14db669093671a54cde8e09712703e8a3cf01817.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722821/0dfec59502c46f76b3a318dc6521ead785459df6.png[/img]

One of the first districts the player gets access to is a working class residential area, and the first step in that is defining the look of the buildings and other key elements within it. Above you can see some of our final black and white concepts for this location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722821/403de787712a8a6c86f3fcf2aeaea01072d93eff.png[/img]

Once the key looks of the district is established we can then create a full-color render of it. This process requires strong attention to color harmony and detail as our content artists will be referencing it with a high degree of specificity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722821/7570e35ee64feb3d0266d0f9a9b102172fb650a0.png[/img]

The art for Taliesin is a huge undertaking and the above mock is not its final form, but even the early results are beautiful. It's clear to see the direction its going, and by looking back there are many steps along the way to ensure it keeps going in that direction. 

Hopefully this has been an exciting look into part of our creation process. Please feel free to share any thoughts or questions in the comments. 

=====

As we approach the end of our campaign we'd like to express our gratitude once more! It's your support that defines our success.

Don’t forget, if you’ve been eyeing a higher reward tier or want to add a limited reward, now is the perfect time to upgrade your pledge! 💪 Once the campaign ends and Kickstarter processes payments, it will be harder to make changes or grab those exclusive items. So make sure to lock in your rewards before time runs out!

Back the project on Kickstarter while you still can: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/datadyne/forge-of-the-fae]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/datadyne/forge-of-the-fae[/url]

notes.title: Stretch Goal Hit: M.Faerie Exploration Mechanic!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722821/62e0f15e12930389ed71c253f29892acc2538f57.png[/img]

As we push toward our next goal, we’re excited to introduce the [b]M.Faerie Exploration Mechanic[/b] – a brand-new way to explore the world of Forge of the Fae! 🧚‍♂️

Meet [b]Fiora’s Mechanical Faerie![/b] Fiora calls it M.Faerie, and her friends affectionately call it “Bug,” a bit to her dismay. The M.Faerie is a trusty, steampunk companion that will soon be able to explore areas that are otherwise unreachable by humans. With this stretch goal unlocked, Bug will have [b]its own mini-game[/b], allowing players to send it into tight spaces and hidden corners of the world, all in search of valuable items, secrets, and new paths.

But here’s the catch—there’s [b]only so much[/b] Bug can do at first. Fiora, being the skilled inventor she is, will need to craft upgrades to improve Bug’s capabilities. Collecting all the goodies from each area will require you to get creative with your upgrades, making the exploration mechanic both[b] strategic and rewarding! 💪[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722821/6c1a39833c5b49758fbb5b9dca1dd0f80611d697.png[/img]

The [b]M.Faerie Exploration Mechanic[/b] will add a fresh layer of gameplay, letting you discover even more secrets in the vast world of Forge of the Fae. ❤️‍🔥

~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~

Your support means the world to us, and if you’re enjoying the campaign, don’t forget to [b]share it with friends[/b] who might love Forge of the Fae too. Let’s make sure [b]no one misses out[/b] on this magical journey [b]before it’s too late![/b] 💪

notes.title: Forge of the Fae Demo and Kickstarter are out now!
notes.content:

[h2]Demo Features:[/h2]
[olist]
[*][b]Rich Storytelling:[/b] Join Fiora, Ceili, and Roark on a short but intriguing journey that sets the stage for greater mysteries.
[*][b]Dynamic Gameplay:[/b] Experience our strategic combat and explore the immersive world of [i]Forge of the Fae[/i].
[*][b]Stunning Visuals and Sound:[/b] Beautiful pixel art, day-night cycles, and an enchanting soundtrack complete the experience.
[/olist]

[h2]Crowdfunding[/h2]
This demo is just the beginning! [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/datadyne/forge-of-the-fae]Forge of the Fae is now live on Kickstarter[/url], and you’ll become part of the game-making process.
